meta.description: Validates docked / generated protein-ligand poses using PoseBusters physical-validity tests, strain energy quantification, geometric checks (planarity, vdW overlap, bond/angle distortion), and pose-energy reasonableness. Use when QC-ing docking results, comparing classical vs ML docking outputs, or filtering pose lists before SAR analysis.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOI/PMID, trial results, or statistics in any output; all numeric results are real bust()/RDKit computations on real docking data, and the cited literature (Buttenschoen 2024, Boström 1998) is real and correctly attributed.

practice_boundaries.detail: Purely computational cheminformatics QC on docked poses; no diagnostic or prescriptive claims about a patient, and no medical-disclaimer requirement applies to this data type.

methodological_ground.detail: The Skill explicitly avoids overgeneralizing benchmark numbers (e.g. 'do not generalize that result to a fixed failure rate on other datasets', 'does not establish a universal acceptance cutoff') and correctly frames strain energy as a diagnostic, not a rigorous free energy.

code_usability.detail: All 5 inputs' code (the Skill's own PoseBusters aggregation pattern, ligand_strain_mmff, and pose_qc_pipeline, each copied unmodified) ran to completion with no syntax errors or missing core dependencies in the tooled env.

functional_suitability.note: Covers PoseBusters QC, strain quantification, standalone planarity snippet, model-specific diagnosis, RMSD/PB-valid reconciliation, and VS-pipeline integration -- complete and well-matched approach. Correctness docked 2 points: two verified factual gaps between documented behavior and installed-tool behavior (config-table completeness, planarity-snippet threshold; see dynamic findings).

reliability.note: Common Errors table covers realistic failure modes (missing rows, wrong receptor format, false positives on covalent, slow strain calc, config errors); strain function returns structured per-row failure notes. Does not address the PDBQT-to-SDF bond-order conversion pitfall a real Vina-docking user will hit before ever calling PoseBusters.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is 293 lines with depth correctly pushed to usage-guide.md and examples/; workflow is linear with no redundant round-trips.

agent_usability.note: Copy-pasteable, consistent code patterns and a clear When-to-Apply table; Common Errors table is good error-prevention but omits the two discrepancies this audit found.

human_usability.note: Description trigger language is natural ('QC-ing docking results', 'filtering pose lists'); strict input validation is appropriate for this data-integrity-sensitive task (Category 3 scene override).

security.note: No secrets, no eval/exec of raw strings; code checks for None/malformed molecules before proceeding rather than trusting input blindly.

maintainability.note: Clean separation across SKILL.md/usage-guide.md/examples/validate_poses.py, each function single-purpose. Testability capped: examples/validate_poses.py ships no sample .sdf/.pdb and its __main__ block is a no-op print statement rather than a runnable smoke test.

agent_specific.note: Precise, well-scoped trigger description; correct progressive disclosure; clean composability via the Related Skills section (virtual-screening, ml-docking-rescoring, conformer-generation, free-energy-calculations); verified idempotent. Escape-hatch guidance ('use as filter, not absolute reject') present but no explicit out-of-scope section.

recommendations.title: 'dock' config table omits that stereo/formula checks, not just RMSD, need mol_true
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's config table says `dock` includes 'All checks except RMSD reference,' implying only RMSD is dropped versus `redock`. Verified: bust(config='dock') returns 22 boolean columns; bust(config='redock', mol_true=...) returns 27 -- the extra 5 are molecular_formula, molecular_bonds, double_bond_stereochemistry, tetrahedral_chirality, and RMSD. The main check table (lines 30-42) lists 'Chirality' and 'Double-bond stereo' as if part of the standard check set without noting they require a reference molecule.
recommendations.root_cause: The check-group table was written from PoseBusters' full ~20-check catalogue rather than verified against the actual column sets each config preset returns in the installed version.
recommendations.fix: Change the `dock` row's 'Includes' text to 'All non-reference checks (drops RMSD, molecular formula/bond identity, and double-bond-stereo/chirality comparison -- these require mol_true).' Add a one-line caveat under the main check table: 'Chirality and double-bond-stereo checks only run when mol_true is supplied (config="redock").'

recommendations.title: Aromatic-ring-planarity snippet's 0.25A cutoff disagrees with real PoseBusters threshold
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's standalone aromatic_planarity() function and the prose 'Aromatic ring deviation > 0.25 A is implausible; flag' state a specific numeric acceptance criterion. Empirically, a pose measuring 0.289A by the Skill's own SVD-max-deviation formula still passed installed PoseBusters 0.6.5's aromatic_ring_flatness check; the real check only started failing between 0.289A and 0.452A on the same perturbation series -- roughly double the documented cutoff.
recommendations.root_cause: The snippet reimplements a simplified max-deviation-from-SVD-plane metric that does not match PoseBusters' internal flatness computation, so the two diverge near the documented threshold.
recommendations.fix: Either drop the numeric 0.25A claim from the standalone snippet (present it as a supplementary diagnostic only) or add: 'This reimplementation is an approximation; treat bust()'s own aromatic_ring_flatness column as authoritative, not this snippet's raw deviation value.'

recommendations.title: No bundled test fixtures; examples/validate_poses.py __main__ is a no-op
recommendations.problem: examples/validate_poses.py ships no sample .sdf/.pdb, and its `if __name__` block only prints 'Example: provide docked.sdf and receptor.pdb to run' rather than executing anything.
recommendations.root_cause: The examples file was written as a function library without an accompanying runnable smoke test or fixture data.
recommendations.fix: Add a small synthetic or public-domain ligand+receptor pair under examples/ and wire the __main__ block to run pose_qc_pipeline against it, so the code path can be verified before adapting it to real data.
